titulo: Present tense in -er and -ir: The three groups in context

aula.objetivo: Conjugate regular -er and -ir verbs in the present, compare all three groups (-ar, -er, -ir), use «y» and «o» with their variants «e» and «u», and avoid the false friend «asistir».

itens.pt: to think that, to believe that

blocos.titulo: Y/e, o/u and verbs with a preposition
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: «y» (and) becomes «e» before a word that starts with the sound «i»: «Ana e Inés», «padres e hijos», «Lee e investiga». This only happens before the sound «i»; before «hie-», it stays «y»: «agua y hielo». STEP 2: «o» (or) becomes «u» before a word that starts with the sound «o»: «siete u ocho», «mujer u hombre», «uno u otro». This only changes the sound, so two «o» sounds don't run together. STEP 3: with «aprender», use «a» + infinitive: «Aprendo a leer en español.» STEP 4: «asistir a» needs «a» before the place or event: «Asisto a clase», «Asistimos a una reunión». STEP 5: «creer que» + clause: «Creo que vive en Valencia.» To say «I think so», use «Creo que sí»; «Creo que no» for the opposite. STEP 6: remember the «personal a» also applies with -er and -ir verbs: «Recibo a Ana», «Escucho a Pablo». STEP 7: the verb agrees with the subject even when there are two of them: «Ana y Pablo viven aquí» (vivir, ellos form).
blocos.comparacao: English «and» and «or» never change form, so this sound-based swap («y»→«e», «o»→«u») has no English equivalent to lean on — it's a genuinely new habit to build. It's brief but constant, and skipping it is one of the things that makes learner Spanish sound less fluent.

tabela.regra: [misto] y becomes e before i-, hi- (except hie-)
[misto] o becomes u before o-, ho-
tabela.traducao: [misto] I have seven or eight books.

erros.motivo: «O» becomes «u» before a word starting with «o».

blocos.titulo: Un día tranquilo / A quiet day
blocos.ru: Hoy es un día tranquilo. Vivo en Valencia con un amigo, Hugo. Hugo lee el periódico y bebe café. Yo aprendo palabras nuevas y escribo una carta. Después comemos juntos: Hugo cocina arroz y yo corto pan. Recibimos a una amiga, Clara, y abrimos la ventana. Clara no come carne, pero come mucha fruta.
blocos.pt: Today is a quiet day. I live in Valencia with a friend, Hugo. Hugo reads the newspaper and has coffee. I'm learning new words and I write a letter. Then we eat together: Hugo cooks rice and I cut bread. We have a friend over, Clara, and we open the window. Clara doesn't eat meat, but she eats a lot of fruit.

blocos.enunciado: Write and say five sentences about your day with verbs from each group (-ar, -er, -ir) and one sentence with «y» or «o».
Fill in the three-group table from memory: for each person, give the form of «hablar», «comer» and «vivir».
